faq.heading: Questions We Get Asked About Acson Air-Conditioners

items.q: How much does it cost to install an Acson air-conditioner?
items.a: The AVO non-inverter starts at RM1,240 for 1.0HP, the Viento inverter from RM1,360, the Reino+ from RM1,695 and the Avory Premium from RM2,130. That price already covers the bracket, ten feet of piping and standard wiring. If longer piping is needed we tell you the extra cost before work starts.

You choose a model and we install a brand-new unit. Monthly payments start at RM69 over 36 months or RM99 over 24 months. The deposit is between RM200 and RM300 depending on horsepower. After the final payment the unit is 100% yours.

items.q: What is included in the rent-to-own package?
items.a: It covers a brand-new Acson unit, professional installation and a one-year warranty. You can add a maintenance plan at RM49 a month, which brings us out to service the unit every three months.

We serve more than 150 towns across 13 states, from Kuala Lumpur and Selangor through to Johor, Penang, Sabah and Sarawak. Every area has its own page on this site. If yours is not listed, WhatsApp us and we will check.
A technician usually arrives one to three days after you confirm. The installation itself takes two to four hours depending on the layout. You pick a time slot that suits you when booking.

items.q: Why choose Acson over other brands?
items.a: Acson is a Malaysian air-conditioner brand owned by Japan's Daikin Industries — Japanese engineering at local pricing. The Reino+ holds a five-star Energy Commission rating and saves up to 48% on electricity. Every model runs on eco-friendly R32 refrigerant.

items.q: What if the unit breaks during the rent-to-own term?
items.a: Within the warranty period we repair or replace it at no charge. After the warranty ends, WhatsApp us for a service — rent-to-own customers get preferential pricing.

items.q: How often should the unit be serviced?
items.a: For home use, a routine service every three to four months plus one chemical wash a year is enough. If the unit runs all day or you live near a dusty road, shorten that to every two months.
